rewards:
All cash and crypto rewards from the Wheel of Fortune are credited directly to the corresponding account balance. For example, if you win ETH, the reward will be added to your ETH wallet balance automatically. 
 For physical rewards or luxury items, our Customer Service team will personally contact you to coordinate delivery.
